description: JVIZ Dot Matrix is a clean and unique Power BI visual for when you need a quick comparison of discrete data across various categories to see how the parts relate to the whole. Switch between various plot area distributions, adjust dot colors and sizing of plot area, and customize the legend and dot conversion labels to represent accurate information. Whether you are a data analyst, project manager, or key stakeholder, JVIZ Dot Matrix provides a professional view into your discrete data. Key Features include: ● 𝗣𝗹𝗼𝘁 𝗗𝗶𝘀𝘁𝗿𝗶𝗯𝘂𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻: Graph proportional or weighted data. ● 𝗗𝗼𝘁 𝗦𝘁𝘆𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗴: Adjust size, color, spacing and radius. ● 𝗗𝗼𝘁 𝗖𝗼𝗻𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻: Visualize large volumes of discrete data. ● 𝗖𝘂𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗺 𝗟𝗲𝗴𝗲𝗻𝗱: Visualize dot color map and weight conversion. ● 𝗣𝗹𝗼𝘁 𝗗𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻: Swap plot direction and dot column visibility. ● 𝗛𝗲𝗹𝗽𝗳𝘂𝗹 𝗜𝗻𝗳𝗼: Toggle the display of warning labels.
